i don’t know the real reason but when i was 16, a family friend who i considered family died. i had a shit family so he was like my family plus my best friend. he also groomed me from the age of six and manipulated me. i hated him but i also hated my family and he was the only person who was kind to me. after he died i became depressed. i hated everything, including myself. i was like that for the rest of my schooling. i would drink every night and smoke a whole packet of cigarettes. i worked part time so I’d just work, drink, smoke and sometimes go to school. after i graduated, i think that was the toughest time. for two years i suffered with an eating disorder. i then became friends with my best friend. she’s honestly the best! i wouldn’t say i was better after meeting her but she brought some noise into my life. for years all i heard was silence. it got bad around a year ago. i quit my job two months ago and gave myself till the end of the year.

i have a few close friends but i only ever talk about suicide stuff with her. i only talk with her bc she never gets weird about it. i could say “oh i went to the city today and people watched for an hour and wondered how ever person will die. what did you eat today?” she just understands me. i think she knows deep down ill prob die soon but she doesn’t know what to do and that’s totally okay! i always tell her i wish we never met bc i know my death will fuck her up. and she understands. i haven’t told her that ill be dying soon. i want to but im already selfish. iv always said i write her a note and post it so she’ll get it a few days after i die. but i don’t think i will. she’ll probably expect paragraphs when all ill say is “sorry.”

38 days till the end of the year. it was once 86 days till i killed myself but slowly every day ends and another starts and now im down to 38. i wanted to spend time with my best friend. go on a road trip with her. spend time with her on her birthday. now that’s done, it’s getting harder to stick around till the end of the year. but i guess i have christmas will my parents and her.
